disclosures.storage: LangGraph InMemoryStore; fresh process and store per benchmark case
disclosures.writePolicy: Store each accepted event text under its fixture event ID; include tentative events only for an explicit tentative view
disclosures.retrievalPolicy: LangGraph vector search over the text field; question text as query; fixture topK or 5
disclosures.providerCostBoundary: Local CPU embeddings only; no LLM, API key, or remote inference provider
notes: Retrieval-only adapter: it intentionally returns unsupported for typed answers and emits no proof citations.
First execution downloads the pinned 67 MB embedding model; benchmark wall time excludes model initialization and dependency startup.
